solution.text:
出题者：彩风版赋格，温停眉
关键词：钱、币种
彩蛋：抢来的
第一层是单表替换，替换成明文之后是：
arrrr since you have asked, i will tell you about our adventure, for a proud pirate never hides his past. our ship has been to many places. oh yes, our name is feared in all the great cities of manila, colombo, washington, amsterdam, algiers, madrid, and bucharest, and from each city we carried away our souvenirs, what you see there in the treasure chests
confused? i fear i have already said too much of our trade's secret. think about it, and maybe one day you'll be a great pirate too
文中的 7 个城市比较显眼，分别是马尼拉，科伦坡，华盛顿，阿姆斯特丹，阿尔及尔，马德里，布加勒斯特。这些城市又分别是菲律宾，斯利郎卡，美国，荷兰，阿尔及利亚，西班牙，罗马尼亚的首都。
根据钱币符号和币种的提示，取上述国家的货币代码：PHP、 LKR、 USD、 NLG、 DZD、 ESP、 ROL。
取七个代码的首字母，即 plunder（抢劫）。
